content.title: Factor Normalization for Deep Neural Network Models
content.abstract: Deep neural network (DNN) models often involve features of high dimensions. In most cases, the high-dimensional features can be decomposed into two parts. The first part is a low-dimensional factor. The second part is the residual feature, with much-reduced variability and inter-feature correlation. This leads to a number of interesting theoretical findings for deep neural network training. Accordingly, we are inspired to develop a new factor normalization method for better performance. The proposed method leads to a new deep learning model with two important features. First, it allows factor related feature extraction. Second, it allows adaptive learning rates for factors and residuals, respectively. This leads to fast convergence speed on both training and validation datsets. A number of empirical experiments are presented to demonstrate its superior performance. The code is available at https://github.com/HazardNeo4869/FactorNormalization
content.one-sentence_summary: We develop a new factor normalization method for fast deep neural network training.
